title: Circuit evaluator runs within a quadratic bound
statement: For every Boolean word $z$ and either choice of the mode parameter, the associated two-work-tape Turing machine halts after exactly $12(|z|+1)^2$ steps, outputs the one-symbol word whose bit is the machine's verdict on $z$, and uses some finite amount of work-tape space.
hypotheses_covered: the machine halts at the specified time
the output is the singleton verdict word
there exists a space bound attained at that time
